name: search_personnel
description: Search people in the local RFFF catalog by name, ORCID, or affiliation. Returns person rows together with every proposal each person appears on (proposal_number, proposal_title, proposal_role, person_overall_assessment). Person-centric questions are first-class: people recur across roughly ten proposals each, so prefer this tool over scanning proposals when the query is about a person. Provide at least one of name, orcid, or affiliation (an empty search is invalid_args). name matches first/middle/last names case-insensitively; orcid is an exact identifier match; affiliation matches the person's affiliation names across their proposals. person_overall_assessment is an opaque stored value — report it verbatim, never compute or explain it. The returned person_orcid values are the bridge identifiers accepted by search_wdp_person.

name.description: Person name, matched case-insensitively against first/middle/last names.

affiliation.description: Affiliation name, matched case-insensitively against the person's affiliations on proposals.

limit.description: Maximum person rows to return; the server additionally caps every response at MCP_MAX_ROWS.

proposals.description: Every proposal this person appears on.

person_overall_assessment.description: Opaque stored value; report verbatim only.
